note: Dates describe when work happened, not when this public archive was committed. Month-level dates are used where precise dates are not established.

milestones.title: Starting the research question
milestones.description: The initial research and planning began with a question about how people make security decisions, not only what they remember from awareness training.
milestones.evidence: Project-origin chronology shared by the researcher

milestones.title: Building the capstone
milestones.description: Development started as a cybersecurity capstone. The aim was to turn social-engineering scenarios into decisions participants could experience, rather than only read about.
milestones.evidence: Capstone development chronology shared by the researcher

milestones.title: Capstone research and first study
milestones.description: The capstone research was completed and an exploratory pilot was conducted with 20 participants. Static training and a standardized phishing exercise preceded VISHWAR simulations. These stages measured different things and should not be presented as a causal comparison.
milestones.evidence: Capstone and exploratory-pilot discussion; exact month not yet assigned

milestones.title: Refining behavioral measurement
milestones.description: Work focused on decision patterns, reporting and response timing, repeat-risk events, and the question of what a combined measure can reasonably say about behavior. Some scoring designs were proposals rather than validated findings.
milestones.evidence: April 2026 platform and dashboard design discussions

milestones.title: Explaining the research through scenarios
milestones.description: The public-facing framing connected influence tactics, branching simulation decisions, and the Identify, Test, Patch, Verify, Report learning cycle. Educational and school-oriented scenarios became a clearer focus.
milestones.evidence: May 2026 VISHWAR methodology and school teaser work

milestones.title: Revisiting what the pilot can tell us
milestones.description: A secondary analysis revisited the pilot and the difference between recognizing risk and acting under pressure. Cross-vector behavior, repeated exposure, and limits of the comparison remained central questions.

milestones.title: Opening a separate public research record
milestones.description: This repository was created to make the shareable research history easier to follow while keeping production implementation and sensitive material out of the public archive.
